q_current_paradigm_ceiling.title: Ring-Zero: Scaling Zero RL to a Trillion Parameters for Emergent Reasoning
q_current_paradigm_ceiling.author: Tang et al.
q_current_paradigm_ceiling.quote: Scaling to 1T parameters significantly enhances sample efficiency and performance ceilings
q_current_paradigm_ceiling.note: Empirical evidence that RL on base models keeps yielding gains at trillion-parameter scale — the case for headroom in the current recipe.

q_current_paradigm_ceiling.title: The next big breakthrough will be AIs learning on the job
q_current_paradigm_ceiling.author: Dwarkesh Patel
q_current_paradigm_ceiling.quote: Around 30-50% of a lab's compute goes to inference, and that compute is currently not really doing anything productive in helping improve the model.
q_current_paradigm_ceiling.note: Argues the current paradigm wastes deployment experience and that on-the-job learning, not further scaling, is the next necessary breakthrough.

q_current_paradigm_ceiling.title: What's Continual Learning, and Why Might We Expect To See It In Advanced LLM Agents?
q_current_paradigm_ceiling.author: RohanS, Arike, Terry, Menon, Jin, Ward & Herd
q_current_paradigm_ceiling.quote: Weight updates are probably needed for some parts of effective CL since LLMs seem quite bad at handling lots of interrelated complexity in their context window
q_current_paradigm_ceiling.note: Argues in-context learning alone is not enough for continual learning, implying a real gap in the current architecture.

q_current_paradigm_ceiling.title: On Dwarkesh Patel's 2026 Podcast With Dario Amodei
q_current_paradigm_ceiling.author: Zvi Mowshowitz
q_current_paradigm_ceiling.quote: If you talk to them for the course of an hour, it's hard to tell them apart from a generally well-educated human
q_current_paradigm_ceiling.note: Documents and critiques Amodei's position that the scaling recipe still holds and continual learning is not a required ingredient.

q_agent_task_horizons.title: Expenditure Horizon: Measuring Optimization Ability
q_agent_task_horizons.author: Cunningham, Shetty, Cheng & Rush
q_agent_task_horizons.quote: We define an agent's 'expenditure horizon' over an optimization problem as the dollar value at which the improvement to the goal metric is equal to the improvement by a human with the same budget.
q_agent_task_horizons.note: A dollar-denominated complement to time horizon; finds current agents add little value on an open-ended AI R&D optimization task.

q_agent_task_horizons.title: The Fallacy of the 16-hour Agent
q_agent_task_horizons.author: Katie Parrott
q_agent_task_horizons.quote: Benchmarks don't measure model capability alone. They measure model capability after a human has done the work
q_agent_task_horizons.note: Pushback on headline horizon numbers: the 80%-reliability horizon is far shorter, and benchmark tasks embed human scaffolding.

q_agent_task_horizons.title: I underestimated AI capabilities (again)
q_agent_task_horizons.author: Ajeya Cotra
q_agent_task_horizons.quote: In 2025, agent time horizons doubled every ~3.5 months, not every ~7 months as in the long-run trend
q_agent_task_horizons.note: A forecaster publicly revises upward after the 2025 acceleration and works through what sustained growth would imply.

q_agent_task_horizons.title: METR Time Horizons: Now 10x/Year
q_agent_task_horizons.author: johncrox
q_agent_task_horizons.quote: AI models are now improving on METR's Time Horizon benchmark at about 10x per year, compared to ~3x per year before 2024.
q_agent_task_horizons.note: Argues the horizon curve has broken upward from its long-run trend.

q_safety_evidence.title: America's Next Top (Cyber) Model
q_safety_evidence.author: Tom Uren
q_safety_evidence.quote: In the short term, cyber organizations should have access to a version of Claude, sans its cyber guardrails.
q_safety_evidence.note: Argues from real-system cyber testing that guardrail evidence and access decisions should differ by user — complicating one-size-fits-all safety cases.

q_safety_evidence.title: Clear, Compelling Arguments: Rethinking the Foundations of Frontier AI Safety Cases
q_safety_evidence.author: Feakins, Habli & Morgan
q_safety_evidence.quote: Safety cases are structured, defensible arguments that a system is acceptably safe to deploy in a given context.
q_safety_evidence.note: Brings safety-engineering discipline to frontier safety cases and questions whether current foundations are sound.

q_safety_evidence.title: Evaluation Awareness: Why Frontier AI Models Are Getting Harder to Test
q_safety_evidence.author: Maheshwari & O'Brien
q_safety_evidence.venue: Institute for AI Policy and Strategy
q_safety_evidence.quote: When a model is 'evaluation-aware' and recognizes it is being tested, it may strategically modify its behavior to appear less dangerous.
q_safety_evidence.note: Names evaluation awareness as a structural threat to the validity of the evals safety cases depend on.

q_safety_evidence.title: International AI Safety Report 2026
q_safety_evidence.author: Bengio (chair) et al.
q_safety_evidence.quote: In 2025, 12 companies published or updated Frontier AI Safety Frameworks – documents that describe how they plan to manage risks
q_safety_evidence.note: The consensus scientific survey documents the spread of safety frameworks and endorses layered risk management over any single form of evidence.

q_ai_companionship.title: The Common Sense Media Census: AI Use by Tweens and Teens, 2026
q_ai_companionship.author: Common Sense Media
q_ai_companionship.quote: Kids who use AI daily or weekly are more likely than infrequent or non-users to report feeling lonely.
q_ai_companionship.note: First annual national census of youth AI use; links frequent use to loneliness and to feeling more understood by AI than by people.

q_ai_companionship.title: AI companionship poses risks for teen development
q_ai_companionship.author: Ha, Figueroa, McGray et al. (ASU)
q_ai_companionship.venue: ASU News / The Lancet Child & Adolescent Health
q_ai_companionship.quote: If you're given full satisfaction on everything, you don't have learning experience with challenges or obstacles.
q_ai_companionship.note: Developmental-psychology work naming relational displacement as the mechanism by which frictionless companionship could stunt relationship skills.

q_ai_companionship.title: How Does Turning to AI for Companionship Predict Loneliness and Vice Versa?
q_ai_companionship.author: Folk & Dunn
q_ai_companionship.quote: Increased social chatbot use predicted increased loneliness, using a single-item measure of emotional isolation.
q_ai_companionship.note: Longitudinal evidence for a bidirectional loop: lonely people turn to chatbots, and chatbot use then predicts more loneliness.

q_ai_companionship.title: Can AI Companions Replace Human Relationships? Intimacy, Dependence, and the Future of Connection
q_ai_companionship.author: Zhang, Zhang & Liu
q_ai_companionship.quote: Whether it ultimately augments or erodes human connection will depend on how asymmetric intimacy is designed, regulated, and integrated into everyday life.
q_ai_companionship.note: Reframes augment-versus-displace as contingent on how asymmetric intimacy is designed and regulated, not an inherent property of the technology.

q_labor_displacement.title: Rethinking Automation Risk: AI Applicability and Occupational Outcomes, 2019–24
q_labor_displacement.author: Broady, Dunson & Barr
q_labor_displacement.quote: task-based measures of technological exposure are better understood as indicators of occupational restructuring than as direct forecasts of employment decline
q_labor_displacement.note: New occupational-outcomes evidence for 2019–24: AI exposure predicts restructuring of work rather than employment decline.

q_labor_displacement.title: A Significant Increase in Digital Labor Automation
q_labor_displacement.author: Mantas Mazeika
q_labor_displacement.quote: Fable 5 reaches the highest automation rate measured so far, 15.8%, roughly double Opus 4.8 at 8.3%.
q_labor_displacement.note: Remote Labor Index update: the measured automation rate of real freelance projects roughly doubled in one model generation.

q_labor_displacement.title: Anthropic Economic Index report: Learning curves
q_labor_displacement.author: Anthropic
q_labor_displacement.quote: Figure 1.3 shows that augmentation in Claude.ai increased slightly. This was driven by small bumps in validation and learning patterns.
q_labor_displacement.note: Usage data showing augmentation grew on the consumer surface while automation fell in API use — against expectations of a steady shift toward automation.

q_labor_displacement.title: What do "economic value" benchmarks tell us?
q_labor_displacement.author: Brand & Burnham
q_labor_displacement.quote: High scores on the benchmarks, therefore, would not imply end-to-end automation of digital professions.
q_labor_displacement.note: Methodological critique: GDPval and RLI tasks are too self-contained to forecast full occupational automation.

q_entry_level_work.title: What is really happening to jobs? Separating AI hype from reality
q_entry_level_work.author: Mahoney, McEntarfer & Wahal
q_entry_level_work.quote: AI's impact on aggregate employment is likely small right now.
q_entry_level_work.note: Skeptical assessment co-authored by a former BLS commissioner: current aggregate labor-market effects are small.

q_entry_level_work.title: AI Economic Indicators: June 2026 Update
q_entry_level_work.author: Stanford Digital Economy Lab
q_entry_level_work.quote: employment in AI-exposed occupations is contracting at 3.8% per year
q_entry_level_work.note: Updated canaries data: continued employment contraction for early-career workers in AI-exposed occupations while other employment grows.

q_entry_level_work.title: AI Is Not Reducing Employment but Rather Who Gets Hired
q_entry_level_work.author: Lodefalk, Löthman, Koch & Engberg
q_entry_level_work.quote: Generative AI is not reducing employment, but it is changing who gets hired.
q_entry_level_work.note: Firm-level evidence that AI adoption shifts hiring composition away from junior roles without reducing total employment.

q_entry_level_work.title: Canaries, Interest Rates, and Timing
q_entry_level_work.author: Brynjolfsson, Chandar & Chen
q_entry_level_work.quote: While interest rates affect overall employment, existing evidence does not suggest they are a good explanation for the disproportionate decline in entry-level hiring in AI-exposed occupations.
q_entry_level_work.note: The canaries authors' direct rebuttal to critics who attribute young-worker declines to interest rates rather than AI.

q_export_controls.title: From Huawei to DeepSeek: the galapagosization of Chinese tech deepens
q_export_controls.author: Robert Wu
q_export_controls.quote: Huawei cannot use global-standard tools or fabrication processes, it is forced to build an entirely separate, vertically integrated ecosystem.
q_export_controls.note: Argues the controls are pushing China to build a self-contained parallel stack — substitution accelerated rather than progress delayed.

q_export_controls.title: AI export controls are not the best bargaining chip
q_export_controls.author: Rowan Wilkinson
q_export_controls.quote: the policy itself is based on a hardware-centric approach to AI capabilities that the technology has since outgrown
q_export_controls.note: Argues the controls rest on outdated hardware-centric assumptions and should not be traded as diplomatic leverage.

q_export_controls.title: How Much Compute Does China Have?
q_export_controls.author: Aqib Zakaria
q_export_controls.quote: Both estimates were roughly 2.8 million H100e, and the convergence of estimates suggests we may be on the right track.
q_export_controls.note: Bottom-up estimate of China's AI compute stock — an empirical baseline for judging whether the controls bind.

q_export_controls.title: A Changing Export Control Landscape: H200 Exports, Remote Access Rules, and What Comes Next
q_export_controls.author: Tang & Tran
q_export_controls.quote: January 2026 underscored how quickly U.S. AI export controls are evolving.
q_export_controls.note: Documents the January 2026 shift reopening H200 sales to China alongside congressional moves against remote cloud access to compute.

q_concentration_of_power.title: It's time for the SEC to come to the table on OpenAI
q_concentration_of_power.author: Aguilar & Bracy
q_concentration_of_power.quote: The SEC has a clear responsibility to ensure investors are aware of the unprecedented nature of OpenAI's governance structure, the conflicts of interest, and the risks involved.
q_concentration_of_power.note: The advocates who secured California oversight of OpenAI's restructuring propose securities disclosure as a concrete accountability lever.

q_concentration_of_power.title: Request for proposals on extreme power concentration
q_concentration_of_power.author: Longview Philanthropy
q_concentration_of_power.quote: If power became extremely concentrated, it could translate into a global regime that could last for many generations into the future.
q_concentration_of_power.note: A funder's problem statement treating AI-enabled power concentration as a distinct research field and directing money at mitigations.

q_concentration_of_power.title: AI Overconcentration and the End of the Balance of Power?
q_concentration_of_power.author: Jesse Marks
q_concentration_of_power.quote: A world in which whoever controls frontier AI can determine the political and economic outcomes of every other actor, with no check on that power, is a novel scenario
q_concentration_of_power.note: Applies balance-of-power theory from international relations to frontier AI control.

q_concentration_of_power.title: When Decentralization Fails
q_concentration_of_power.author: Alex Chalmers
q_concentration_of_power.quote: Freedom has never depended on power being small. It has depended on power being answerable to more than one authority at a time
q_concentration_of_power.note: Counterpoint to decentralization advocates: accountability through competing institutions matters more than dispersing capability.
